comment: IEEE 802.15.4 2.4 GHz O-QPSK frames: the synchronization header (preamble and SFD) found and taken off, the PHY
header read, each PSDU (the MAC frame with its FCS) a message, captured for Wireshark as 802.15.4 with FCS.
Transmitting, each call is one PSDU, the SHR and PHR put before it. The 2450 PHY's limits hold:
no carrier estimator, and no search for where its 32-chip symbols start (the samples start on a symbol)
